## What are you trying to do?

Name the skill or recipe and describe the expected result.

## What happened?

Include the command or prompt and the error or unexpected output.

## Environment

AEA tag or commit (`git rev-parse HEAD`), operating system, Python/MNE versions,
agent client and version, and reviewer model if relevant.

## Example

Link a public dataset or provide a small synthetic example, with the event mapping
and relevant plan settings. Mention any steps you have already tried.
